city.name: Shizuoka
city.intro: A castle town between the Abe River and Suruga Bay, where craftsmen gathered in Tokugawa Ieyasu’s time. Suruga wood joinery and Shizuoka tea, together with pottery, coffee and sweets across Aoi, Takajo, Mariko and Shimizu, as Rin’s picks.
city.introJa: 安倍川と駿河湾のあいだに広がる、徳川家康ゆかりの城下町。駿河の指物と静岡茶、葵区・鷹匠・丸子・清水の器と珈琲、菓子を、凛のおすすめで。

locator.en: On Suruga Bay · between the Abe River and the mountains
locator.ja: 駿河湾に面し・安倍川と山あいのあいだの町

industries.about: Suruga sashimono wood joinery grew out of the craftspeople who gathered around Sunpu Castle. In Shizuoka, workshops such as Kichizo still handcraft mulberry-wood joinery, cabinets and everyday wooden wares.
industries.aboutJa: 駿河指物は、駿府城の築城などに集まった職人たちから始まった木工。静岡では、吉蔵のような工房がいまも島桑の指物や暮らしの調度品を手仕事で作る。
industries._src: Rooted in the craftsmen gathered to build Sumpu Castle, known for sophisticated wooden boxes, mirrors, and joinery furniture.

industries.about: Shizuoka is one of Japan’s leading tea regions, known for deep-steamed sencha as well as mountain-grown single-origin teas. In town, century-old tea wholesalers such as Chamachi Kinzaburo pair Shizuoka teas with matcha sweets.
industries.aboutJa: 静岡は日本有数のお茶の産地で、深蒸し煎茶や山間の単一産地のお茶が知られる。街なかでは茶町KINZABUROのような老舗茶問屋の店が、静岡茶と抹茶菓子を出している。
industries._src: Japan's preeminent green tea capital, celebrated for deep-steamed sencha (fukamushi-cha) and modern single-origin tea culture.

駿府の工房 匠宿.what: 駿河区丸子の伝統工芸体験施設。駿河竹千筋細工や和染、木工、漆、陶芸の工房と、ギャラリーやカフェがある。火曜定休。
駿府の工房 匠宿.whatEn: A traditional craft centre in Mariko, Suruga-ku. Workshops for Suruga bamboo ware, dyeing, woodwork, lacquer and pottery, with a gallery and café. Closed Tuesdays.
駿府の工房 匠宿.note: 竹千筋細工か木工か、ひとつ選んで手を動かしてみたい。
駿府の工房 匠宿.noteEn: I would pick one craft—bamboo ware or woodwork—and try making something.

_src.nameKana: すんぷのこうぼう たくみしゅく
_src.whatJa: 旧東海道・丸子宿の自然に囲まれた、駿河竹千筋細工や木工、陶芸などの伝統工芸を体験・鑑賞できる複合工芸施設。
_src.whatEn: A contemporary timber-and-tile craft village in the bamboo hills along the historic Tokaido highway celebrating traditional Shizuoka handcrafts.
_src.facts: Nestled in Mariko-juku along the Tokaido; renovated into a sleek modern craft complex with working studios and galleries; features on-site artisan hands-on workshops in bamboo and woodworking.
_src.weak: Located about 30 minutes by bus from central Shizuoka station.
_src.quote: 2026年11月20日（金）から11月29日（日）まで、駿府の工房 匠宿にて、企画展「食と工芸」を開催いたします。
_src.fixes: Address matches (〒421-0103 静岡市駿河区丸子3240-1). Page says: open 9:30-18:00, closed Tuesday; experiences are 駿河竹千筋細工・和染・木工・漆・陶芸; billed as 日本最大級の伝統工芸体験施設. 'timber-and-tile' and 'bamboo hills' in whatEn are not on the page. whatJa is fine but should not claim 旧東海道 nature wording as verified.

元祖 丁子屋.what: 慶長元年（1596年）創業の、丸子のとろろ汁の店。歌川広重や芭蕉ゆかりの老舗で、木曜定休（月末は水・木）。
元祖 丁子屋.whatEn: A tororo-jiru grated yam restaurant in Mariko founded in 1596, with ties to Hiroshige and Basho. Closed Thursdays (and the last Wednesday of the month).
元祖 丁子屋.note: まずは定番のとろろ汁。由比の桜えびの季節ならそれも。
元祖 丁子屋.noteEn: The classic tororo-jiru first, and sakura shrimp if it is in season.

_src.nameKana: がんそ ちょうじや
_src.whatJa: 慶長元年（1596年）創業、歌川広重の浮世絵にも描かれた茅葺き屋根の老舗で名物のとろろ汁を提供する食事処。
_src.whatEn: A historic post-town restaurant founded in 1596 serving grated wild yam tororo-jiru under a traditional thatched roof.
_src.facts: Founded in 1596 during the Azuchi-Momoyama period; immortalized in Utagawa Hiroshige's 'The Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido'; serves grated natural yam beaten with white dashi and egg over mugimeshi barley rice.
_src.weak: Extremely popular on weekends with potential waits during peak lunch hours.
_src.quote: １１月９日より　大好評！由比漁港直送　旬の桜えびセット
_src.fixes: Address matches (〒421-0103 静岡市駿河区丸子7-10-10). Founding 慶長元年（1596年）confirmed on /company and /history; Hiroshige, Basho, Jippensha Ikku named on /history. 茅葺き (thatched roof) not found on the pages read, so do not state it as verified. Hours on the site: Mon-Fri 11:00-14:00, closed Thursday (end of month: Wed and Thu). Top page also has '【11/12(木)定休日営です】'.

うつわ 暮らしの道具 テクラ.what: 葵区大岩の、器と暮らしの道具の店。全国の作り手の陶磁器や木工、民具を扱い、展示会も開く。13時から17時、火・水曜定休。
うつわ 暮らしの道具 テクラ.whatEn: A shop for vessels and daily tools in Oiwa, Aoi-ku, carrying ceramics, woodwork and folk crafts from makers across Japan and holding exhibitions. Open 13:00–17:00, closed Tue–Wed.
うつわ 暮らしの道具 テクラ.note: 全国の焼きものや民具を、棚の前でひとつずつ手に取ってみたい。
うつわ 暮らしの道具 テクラ.noteEn: I would take my time at the shelves, picking up the pottery and folk crafts one by one.

_src.nameKana: うつわ くらしのどうぐ てくら
_src.whatJa: 全国の作り手による陶磁器や木工品、手仕事の生活道具を丁寧にセレクトして展示販売するうつわと暮らしの店。
_src.whatEn: A thoughtful craft gallery and shop introducing handcrafted tableware, woodcraft, and daily lifestyle utensils by Japanese artisans.
_src.facts: Curates functional everyday ceramics from pottery regions across Japan including folk art mingei lineages; hosts monthly rotating solo and group craft exhibitions; located in a quiet residential neighborhood at the foot of Shizuhata Mountain.
_src.weak: Closed on Tuesdays and Wednesdays with afternoon-only opening hours (13:00-17:00).
_src.quote: 2026.11.06（金）〜09（月） わら細工たくぼ販売会 ＠日本橋髙島屋

手打ち蕎麦 たがた.what: 葵区常磐町の手打ち蕎麦の店。静岡の山奥の在来蕎麦を使い、昼は予約なし、夜は予約可。日曜夜と月曜定休、蕎麦がなくなり次第終了。
手打ち蕎麦 たがた.whatEn: A handmade soba shop in Tokiwa-cho, Aoi-ku, using heirloom mountain buckwheat from Shizuoka. Walk-ins at lunch, reservations at dinner; closed Sunday evening and Monday.
手打ち蕎麦 たがた.note: 昼の開店に合わせて、在来蕎麦の香りを確かめにいきたい。
手打ち蕎麦 たがた.noteEn: I would go at lunch opening to taste the aroma of their heirloom buckwheat.

_src.nameKana: てうちそば たがた
_src.whatJa: 静岡の奥地で継承されてきた貴重な在来種蕎麦を自ら育て石臼挽き手打ちで提供する、全国の蕎麦通が注目する名店。
_src.whatEn: A celebrated artisanal soba restaurant pioneering the cultivation and hand-milling of rare indigenous Shizuoka mountain buckwheat.
_src.facts: Chef Tagata actively revitalizes rare indigenous buckwheat varieties like Ikawa Zairai from the Southern Alps foothills; grinds flour daily on custom stone mills; pairs fresh seasonal soba with local Shizuoka sake and wasabi from Utougi.
_src.weak: Soba dough portions are limited daily; advance reservations or early arrival recommended.
_src.quote: イベント出店のお知らせ！JIMI SHIZUOKA KITCHEN
_src.fixes: Address 静岡県静岡市葵区常磐町2-6-7 confirmed on official About page. Page does not mention stone-mill grinding or growing buckwheat himself in the text I read, so keep whatJa wording about 石臼挽き/自ら育て cautious; the About page says 在来蕎麦 is the focus (静岡の山奥の在来蕎麦). Hours: lunch 11:30-14:00, dinner 17:30-21:00, closed Sunday night and Monday. Instagram profile (@teuchisobatagata) opened, but content was login/rate-limited.

茶町KINZABURO.what: 葵区土太夫町の、創業百余年の茶問屋・前田金三郎商店が営む静岡茶と抹茶スイーツの店。2階のイートインでは10種類のお茶を味わえる。水曜定休。
茶町KINZABURO.whatEn: A Shizuoka tea and matcha sweets shop in Dodaiyu-cho, Aoi-ku, run by century-old tea wholesaler Maeda Kinzaburo Shoten. Ten teas are served in the upstairs eat-in space. Closed Wednesdays.
茶町KINZABURO.note: 二階で十種類のお茶を飲み比べて、抹茶菓子をひとつ選ぶ。
茶町KINZABURO.noteEn: Try the ten teas upstairs and pick one matcha sweet to go with them.

_src.nameKana: ちゃまち きんざぶろう
_src.whatJa: 創業百余年の茶問屋・前田金三郎商店が運営する、静岡茶と自社工房製抹茶スイーツの専門店。
_src.whatEn: A Shizuoka green tea and matcha sweets shop run by century-old tea wholesaler Maeda Kinzaburo Shoten with an upstairs tea-tasting lounge.
_src.facts: Operated by Maeda Kinzaburo Shoten, marking its 111th anniversary in 2026; first floor sells Shizuoka green teas alongside house-made baked and fresh matcha sweets; sunlit second-floor eat-in space offers complimentary self-serve tastings of around 11 types of tea.
_src.weak: Closed on Wednesdays; Sunday and holiday hours close at 17:00.
_src.quote: 冬のギフト　早期ご予約割引実施中です！ 11月24日(火）まで

株式会社吉蔵.what: 葵区住吉町の、1922年創業の指物工房。島桑指物や厨子仏壇、暮らしの調度品を手仕事で作る。
株式会社吉蔵.whatEn: A sashimono joinery workshop in Sumiyoshi-cho, Aoi-ku, founded in 1922. Handcrafts mulberry-wood joinery, household cabinets and small wooden wares.
株式会社吉蔵.note: 島桑の指物や日用の木工小物を、近くで見てみたい。
株式会社吉蔵.noteEn: I would like to see their mulberry-wood joinery and small wooden wares up close.

_src.nameKana: かぶしきがいしゃ きちぞう
_src.whatJa: 1922年創業、三代にわたり職人の手仕事で指物家具や島桑指物、暮らしの調度品を一貫製作する木工所。
_src.whatEn: A third-generation sashimono wood joinery studio founded in 1922 handcrafting Japanese wooden cabinets, shrines, and everyday wooden wares.
_src.facts: Founded in 1922 by sashimono craftsman Yoshizo Sugiyama and now led by third-generation head Yoshitaka Sugiyama; crafts mulberry-wood joinery (Shimaguku sashimono), Joseon-inspired cabinets, shrines, and small daily wooden accessories; guided by the ideal of furniture sized and weighted for one person to carry.
_src.weak: Primarily a working joinery workshop and gallery; contact ahead before visiting.
_src.verifiedBy: https://www.kichizo.co.jp/post/静岡伊勢丹「指物吉蔵」暮らしの調度-（2026年初夏）のご案内

cotory.what: 葵区伝馬町の裏通り、ビルの2階にある雑貨店。大切に使われてきたものと、使い続けたい手仕事の道具を扱い、企画展も開く。火曜定休。
cotory.whatEn: A small second-floor shop on a backstreet in Tenma-cho, Aoi-ku, carrying well-made daily tools and holding craft exhibitions. Closed Tuesdays.
cotory.note: 二階の静かな棚で、長く使えそうな道具を探してみたい。
cotory.noteEn: In the quiet second-floor room, I would look for a daily tool meant to last.

_src.nameKana: ことり
_src.whatJa: 伝馬町のビル2階にあり、日本の作り手によるカゴや手仕事の生活道具を紹介する小さな雑貨店。
_src.whatEn: A quiet second-floor lifestyle and craft shop in Tenmacho hosting pop-up showcases of Japanese handwork and everyday tools.
_src.facts: Located in Room 201 of the KK Building in Tenmacho, Aoi Ward; hosts curated pop-up exhibitions with Japanese craft producers such as Niigata-based F/style; features handwoven bamboo baskets, sedge-rope stools, and daily wares.
_src.weak: Tucked on the second floor of a small commercial building; check schedule between exhibitions.

三保原屋本店.what: 1687年（貞享4年）創業、葵区呉服町の暮らしの道具の店。土鍋や台所用品、長く愛用できる日用品を揃える。
三保原屋本店.whatEn: A household goods shop on Gofukucho Street, Aoi-ku, founded in 1687, carrying kitchenware and durable daily tools.
三保原屋本店.note: 台所まわりの道具から、毎日使えるものをひとつ見つけたい。
三保原屋本店.noteEn: I would look through the kitchenware for one piece to use every day.

_src.nameKana: みほはらやほんてん
_src.whatJa: 1687年（貞享4年）創業、呉服町で土鍋や竹製品など永く愛用できる暮らしの道具を提案する老舗家庭用品専門店。
_src.whatEn: A venerable Shizuoka household tools and tableware store founded in 1687 on Gofukucho Street curating clay pots, bamboo wares, and daily utensils.
_src.facts: Founded in 1687 during the Edo period and headquartered in Gofukucho, Aoi Ward; operates just three distinct local shops (Honten, Mihoharaya LOFT, and NEST Yaizu); curates functional kitchenware, seasonal earthen pots, bamboo goods, and Japanese textiles.
_src.weak: Busy central shopping-street location without dedicated on-site parking.
_src.quote: 三保原屋本店にて、久しぶりにスタッフ募集をします。

陶芸しみず春日工房.what: 清水区春日の陶芸家・山本敬之の工房。和食器や花器、白瓷・青瓷を制作し、展示場「器ギャラリーヤマモト」を併設する。13時から17時、水・木曜定休。
陶芸しみず春日工房.whatEn: Potter Takayuki Yamamoto’s studio in Kasuga, Shimizu-ku, making Japanese tableware, vases, white porcelain and celadon, with an attached gallery. Open 13:00–17:00, closed Wed–Thu.
陶芸しみず春日工房.note: 白瓷と青瓷の器を、ギャラリーの棚でじっくり見たい。
陶芸しみず春日工房.noteEn: I would take time at the gallery shelves to look at the white porcelain and celadon.

_src.nameKana: とうげいしみずかすがこうぼう
_src.whatJa: 陶芸家・山本敬之氏が清水区春日で主宰する、和食器や花器、白瓷・青瓷の展示場「器ギャラリーヤマモト」併設の陶芸工房。
_src.whatEn: Potter Takayuki Yamamoto's studio and utensil gallery in Shimizu Ward showcasing handcrafted celadon, white porcelain, and Japanese tableware.
_src.facts: Established in 1996 in Kasuga, Shimizu Ward by ceramicist Takayuki Yamamoto; focuses on Japanese tableware, flower vases, white porcelain (hakuji), and celadon (seiji); houses the on-site exhibition space 'Yamamoto Utensil Gallery' alongside pottery classes.
_src.weak: Residential studio gallery in Shimizu Ward; check open hours before visiting.
_src.quote: 「静岡の工芸2026」開催中

ESORA COFFEE.what: 葵区鷹匠の路地に立つ自家焙煎のロースタリーカフェ。黒い外観と白いのれんが目印で、コーヒーと季節の一皿を出す。
ESORA COFFEE.whatEn: A small roastery café in a Takajo backstreet, marked by a black facade and white noren curtain, serving house-roasted coffee and seasonal plates.
ESORA COFFEE.note: 白いのれんをくぐって、自家焙煎のコーヒーと季節の一皿を。
ESORA COFFEE.noteEn: Through the white noren curtain for house-roasted coffee and a seasonal plate.

_src.nameKana: えそら こーひー
_src.whatJa: 鷹匠の路地に佇み、自家焙煎のコーヒーと季節の素材を重ねたカフェメニューを届けるロースタリーカフェ。
_src.whatEn: A serene backstreet roastery cafe in Takajo pairing house-roasted coffee with seasonal sweets.
_src.facts: Marked its 5th anniversary and entered its 6th year in Takajo in February 2026; roasts beans in-house and sells seasonal single-origin coffees; open 11:00–18:00 (last order 17:30).
_src.weak: Closing days vary; check official Instagram for monthly schedules and sold-out notices.
_src.quote: 現在は静岡市・鷹匠に拠点を移し、ここでの時間もあっという間に半年が過ぎようとしています。

創作珈琲工房 くれあーる.what: 駿河区八幡のスペシャルティコーヒー専門店。10時から19時、日曜定休。
創作珈琲工房 くれあーる.whatEn: A specialty coffee shop and roastery in Yahata, Suruga-ku. Open 10:00–19:00, closed Sundays.
創作珈琲工房 くれあーる.note: 冷めても甘いという豆を、自宅用に一袋選んでみたい。
創作珈琲工房 くれあーる.noteEn: I would pick a bag of beans for home—they say good coffee stays sweet even as it cools.

_src.nameKana: そうさくこーひーこうぼう くれあーる
_src.whatJa: 駿河区八幡に本店を構え、冷めても甘く果物のような爽やかな明るい酸を持つスペシャルティコーヒーを自家焙煎する専門店。
_src.whatEn: An artisanal specialty coffee roaster in Suruga Ward prized for clean, fruit-bright cups that stay sweet even after cooling.
_src.facts: Roasts specialty coffee beans at its Yahata shop in Suruga Ward; emphasizes bright fruit-like acidity and clean sweetness; regularly invited to pour at national department store events such as Nihombashi Takashimaya.
_src.weak: Located in Yahata south of JR Shizuoka Station, about a 15-minute walk.
_src.quote: 創作珈琲工房くれあーるが開店してから３４年が経ちました。

トクナガコーヒー.what: 清水区辻の自家焙煎コーヒー専門店。熱風・直火・炭火・溶岩の4つの焙煎方式を使い分ける。
トクナガコーヒー.whatEn: A house-roasting coffee shop in Tsuji, Shimizu-ku, using four roasting methods: hot-air, direct-flame, charcoal and lava stone.
トクナガコーヒー.note: 富士山の溶岩で焙煎した豆を、まず一袋買って帰りたい。
トクナガコーヒー.noteEn: I would buy a bag of the Mt. Fuji lava-roasted beans to take home.

_src.nameKana: とくながこーひー
_src.whatJa: 創業77年、キャリア57年の熟練焙煎士が清水区で世界のスペシャルティコーヒー豆を自家焙煎する老舗専門店。
_src.whatEn: A 77-year-old family-run specialty coffee roaster in Shimizu Ward led by a master roaster with 57 years of roasting craft.
_src.facts: Operates two local shops in Shimizu Ward (Tsuji main store and Kitayabe branch); roasts farm-traceable single-origin specialty beans alongside Mt. Fuji lava-roasted coffees and cold-brew bags; founded 77 years ago.
_src.weak: Primarily a traditional bean retail roastery rather than a modern sit-down cafe.
_src.quote: ＣＯＬＤ　ＢＲＥＷ　2026年　新たに美味しくなりました！

LA PALETTE.what: 駿河区用宗のジェラート専門店。静岡産の生乳と果物や野菜、特産品を使い、香料や着色料を使わずに作る。
LA PALETTE.whatEn: A gelato shop in Mochimune, Suruga-ku, making gelato from Shizuoka raw milk and local fruits, vegetables and produce without artificial flavourings or colourings.
LA PALETTE.note: 用宗のしらすや藤枝の煎茶など、静岡らしい味を選びたい。
LA PALETTE.noteEn: I would pick a Shizuoka flavour—Mochimune whitebait or Fujieda sencha.

_src.nameKana: ら ぱれっと
_src.whatJa: 用宗海岸の目の前で、静岡県産の生乳と旬の果物・野菜・特産品のみを使い無添加で仕上げるジェラート専門店。
_src.whatEn: A seaside gelato shop right in front of Mochimune Beach handcrafting over 100 flavors exclusively from Shizuoka milk, fruits, and produce.
_src.facts: Uses fresh Shizuoka raw milk with zero artificial flavorings or colorings across a repertoire of over 100 local flavors; features 20 indoor seats and 22 rooftop terrace seats overlooking Mochimune Beach, an eight-minute walk from JR Mochimune Station; operates just two shops (Mochimune flagship and Shimizu).
_src.weak: Situated in coastal Mochimune, two local train stops west of JR Shizuoka Station.
_src.quote: 温かいスイートポテトと冷たいジェラートがとろけ合う、秋冬限定の皿盛りパフェが登場！
_src.fixes: whatJa: 「無添加」は公式ページの表現に合わせ「香料や着色料を使わず」に修正。

ショコラファン.what: 昭和61年（1986年）開店の、葵区鷹匠の洋菓子店。看板のチョコレートケーキ「ショコラファン」のほか、季節の焼き菓子も並ぶ。
ショコラファン.whatEn: A pastry shop in Takajo, Aoi-ku, open since 1986, known for its signature Chocolat Fin chocolate cake alongside seasonal baked sweets.
ショコラファン.note: まずは看板のショコラファンと、焼き菓子をひとつ。
ショコラファン.noteEn: The signature Chocolat Fin cake first, and one baked sweet.

_src.nameKana: しょこらふぁん
_src.whatJa: 昭和61年（1986年）オープン、新静岡駅近くの鷹匠で長年親しまれるチョコレートケーキが看板の老舗洋菓子店。
_src.whatEn: A classic neighborhood cake shop in Takajo beloved since 1986 for its rum-kissed layered chocolate cake and seasonal baked sweets.
_src.facts: Opened in 1986 (Showa 61) a two-minute walk from Shin-Shizuoka Station, named after the French for 'delicate chocolate'; signature 'Chocolat Fin' cake layers rich ganache, chocolate sponge, light chocolate cream, milk chocolate glaze, and rum; offers seasonal financiers and gift pastries.
_src.weak: Takeout-focused neighborhood patisserie.
_src.quote: 可愛い楽しい格好いい‼️そんなはたらくくるまが大集合したお菓子のギフトBOXです❗

VERT CLAIR.what: 駿河区豊田のパティスリー。店内にイートインスペースがあり、ケーキとドリンクのセットが楽しめる。木曜はイートイン休み。
VERT CLAIR.whatEn: A patisserie in Toyoda, Suruga-ku, with an eat-in space for cake and drink sets. Eat-in closed Thursdays.
VERT CLAIR.note: ショーケースからひとつ選んで、店内の席で紅茶といただく。
VERT CLAIR.noteEn: Pick a cake from the case and sit inside with a cup of tea.

_src.nameKana: ゔぇーるくれーる
_src.whatJa: 駿河区豊田にあり、職人が仕立てる生菓子や焼き菓子、ショコラをイートインサロンと共に楽しめる洋菓子店。
_src.whatEn: A patisserie and salon in Suruga Ward offering French fresh cakes, baked confections, and chocolates with an eat-in space.
_src.facts: Crafts fresh cakes, entremets, baked sweets, and chocolates designed for everyday enjoyment; includes an indoor eat-in space and on-site parking in Toyoda, Suruga Ward; takes custom cake and gift-box orders.
_src.weak: Residential Suruga Ward location away from rail stations.
_src.quote: ゴールデンウイーク中は休まず営業いたします。

Patisserie Hirondelle.what: 葵区大岩町のフランス菓子店。プティガトーやヴィエノワズリー、約20種類の焼き菓子を作る。10時から19時、水曜定休。
Patisserie Hirondelle.whatEn: A French patisserie in Oiwa-cho, Aoi-ku, making petit gâteaux, viennoiserie and around twenty kinds of baked sweets. Open 10:00–19:00, closed Wednesdays.
Patisserie Hirondelle.note: 棚に並ぶ約20種類の焼き菓子から、いくつか選んでみたい。
Patisserie Hirondelle.noteEn: I would choose a few from the twenty or so baked sweets on the shelf.

_src.nameKana: ぱてぃすりー いろんでる
_src.whatJa: 葵区大岩町でプティガトーやヴィエノワズリー、約20種類の焼き菓子を手掛けるパティスリー。
_src.whatEn: A neighborhood patisserie in Oiwacho baking petit gateaux, viennoiserie, cream puffs, and around twenty varieties of giftable baked sweets.
_src.facts: Opened in October 2017 in Oiwacho, Aoi Ward; offers petit gateaux, choux cream puffs, viennoiserie, entremets, and roughly 20 types of baked confections; open 10:00–19:00.
_src.weak: Closed every Tuesday and Wednesday.
_src.quote: 10月のお休みです。 毎週、火曜日と水曜日になります。 よろしくお願いします。

ヴィンチスグラッシ.what: 葵区鷹匠のイタリア料理店。イタリア中部マルケ州の家庭料理とパスタを、静岡の野菜も取り入れて作る。14席。水曜・不定休。
ヴィンチスグラッシ.whatEn: A 14-seat Italian restaurant in Takajo, Aoi-ku, cooking home-style dishes and pasta from the Marche region with Shizuoka vegetables. Closed Wednesdays and irregular days.
ヴィンチスグラッシ.note: マルケ州のパスタと、静岡の野菜を使った一皿を頼んでみたい。
ヴィンチスグラッシ.noteEn: I would order a Marche pasta and a dish made with Shizuoka vegetables.

_src.nameKana: ゔぃんちすぐらっし
_src.whatJa: 鷹匠の静鉄日吉町駅近くに店を構える、イタリア・マルケ州の郷土料理とパスタの専門店。
_src.whatEn: An Italian restaurant in Takajo dedicated to the authentic regional cooking and pastas of Italy's Marche region.
_src.facts: Located a three-minute walk from Hiyoshicho Station in Takajo; focuses on traditional regional dishes and pastas of Marche, Italy with curated wine pairings; offers lunch, dinner courses, and scheduled a-la-carte nights.
_src.weak: Closed Wednesdays plus irregular holidays; advance booking recommended.
_src.quote: 2026年12月20日（日）〜25日（金）のディナー

simples.what: 駿河区丸子の里山にあるレストラン。静岡のその日限りの食材を使ったコース料理を出し、指物や漆の職人とも協働する。火曜定休（ランチは土日のみ）。
simples.whatEn: A restaurant in the satoyama hills of Mariko, Suruga-ku, serving tasting courses from daily Shizuoka ingredients and collaborating with local wood and lacquer craftspeople. Closed Tuesdays (lunch weekends only).
simples.note: その日限りの料理と、指物や漆の器との組み合わせを見たい。
simples.noteEn: I would go to see how the daily dishes pair with local joinery and lacquer vessels.

_src.nameKana: さんぷるす
_src.whatJa: 丸子の里山に佇み、その日限りの静岡の食材を使ったコース料理を届けるレストラン。
_src.whatEn: A satoyama tasting-menu restaurant in Mariko highlighting ephemeral daily Shizuoka ingredients and collaborations with local craftspeople.
_src.facts: Set in Mariko near the historic post town and craft valley; collaborates with local artisans including sashimono woodworker Katsuhisa Toda; serves two-seating dinners (17:30 or 19:00) and weekend-only 12:00 lunches.
_src.weak: Lunch is served on weekends only at a 12:00 simultaneous start; reservation required.
_src.quote: シンプルズのコース料理の締めを担うのは、指物職人　戸田勝久さんに作っていただいたお茶菓子箱です。

レストラン ソレイユ.what: 2003年オープンの、葵区鷹匠のフランス料理店。自家製のフォンから作るソースが持ち味。ディナーは前日までの予約制、日曜・月曜不定休。
レストラン ソレイユ.whatEn: A French restaurant in Takajo, Aoi-ku, open since 2003, known for sauces built on house-made stocks. Dinner by reservation a day ahead; closed Sundays and some Mondays.
レストラン ソレイユ.note: 昼のコースで、自家製フォンのソースと選べるデザートを。
レストラン ソレイユ.noteEn: A lunch course for the house-made stock sauces and a dessert from the menu.

_src.nameKana: れすとらん それいゆ
_src.whatJa: 2003年10月オープン、ステンドグラスの扉の奥で自家製フォンと丁寧なソースのフランス料理を提供する鷹匠のレストラン。
_src.whatEn: An intimate French bistro-restaurant in Takajo cooking from-scratch stocks and classic sauces behind a stained-glass door since 2003.
_src.facts: Opened in October 2003 in Takajo, five minutes on foot from Hiyoshicho Station; prepares all stocks (fond) in-house for seasonal lunch and dinner courses such as chicken and mushroom fricassee; intimate dining room seats small groups.
_src.weak: Cash only and reservations accepted by phone only; dinner requires reservation by the previous business day.
_src.quote:
『Xmas特別コース2026』予約開始
毎年恒例のXmas特別コース。今年も開催します！

ÉPICURIEN.what: 葵区鷹匠のモダンフレンチ。静岡の野菜や近海の天然鮮魚、ジビエを使い、昼夜ともおまかせコースで出す。
ÉPICURIEN.whatEn: A modern French restaurant in Takajo, Aoi-ku, serving omakase tasting courses of Shizuoka vegetables, wild coastal fish and seasonal game.
ÉPICURIEN.note: 静岡の野菜と近海の魚が並ぶおまかせコースを、ゆっくり。
ÉPICURIEN.noteEn: Take time over an omakase course of Shizuoka vegetables and coastal fish.

_src.nameKana: えぴきゅりあん
_src.address: 葵区鷹匠1-3-5 メゾンフィール鷹匠 1階
_src.whatJa: 静岡の新鮮な野菜や近海の天然鮮魚、ジビエを使ったコース料理を仕立てる鷹匠のモダンフレンチレストラン。
_src.whatEn: A modern French course restaurant in Takajo showcasing fresh Shizuoka vegetables, wild-caught coastal fish, and seasonal game.
_src.facts: Located on the ground floor of Maison Feel Takajo, an 11-minute walk from JR Shizuoka Station; builds seasonal tasting courses around Shizuoka produce, wild coastal seafood, and selected meats and game; also offers takeout menus.
_src.weak: Course-focused dining requiring advance reservation.
_src.quote:
2026年のクリスマスコースと年末年始についてですが
今年は
12月19日(土)～27日(日)まで
クリスマスランチコース（￥15,000税込）
クリスマスディナーコース（￥25,000税込）
それぞれ通常営業時間にてご用意します。

sights.name: 静岡市美術館
sights.address: 静岡市葵区紺屋町17-1 葵タワー3階
sights.what: JR静岡駅前の葵タワー3階にある市立美術館。美術やデザイン、工芸など幅広い企画展を開く。10時から19時、月曜休館（祝日の場合は翌平日）。
sights.whatEn: A municipal art museum on the 3rd floor of Aoi Tower in front of JR Shizuoka Station, holding exhibitions of art, design and craft. Open 10:00–19:00, closed Mondays (or the following weekday if a holiday).
sights._source: https://shizubi.jp/ (静岡市美術館公式): 2026年11月13日開館 10:00-19:00。住所 〒420-0852 静岡県静岡市葵区紺屋町17-1 葵タワー。

sights.name: 静岡市立芹沢銈介美術館
sights.nameEn: Shizuoka City Serizawa Keisuke Art Museum
sights.what: 静岡出身の染色家・芹沢銈介の作品と収集品を収蔵・展示する美術館。登呂遺跡の一角にあり、白井晟一の設計で1981年に開館した。月曜休館。
sights.whatEn: A museum dedicated to the works and collection of Shizuoka-born dyeing artist Keisuke Serizawa, set at the Toro archaeological site in a 1981 building designed by Seiichi Shirai. Closed Mondays.
sights._source: https://www.seribi.jp/ (公式): 2026年10月10日〜12月13日 開館45周年記念展「街角に息づく芹沢デザイン」開催中。住所 〒422-8033 静岡県静岡市駿河区登呂五丁目10-5。
sights._coordsSource: OSM way 387983835（静岡市立芹沢ケイ介美術館）

sights.name: 駿府城公園
sights.address: 静岡市葵区駿府城公園1-1
sights.what: 徳川家康が晩年を過ごした駿府城の跡を整備した公園。復元された東御門・巽櫓、坤櫓や紅葉山庭園があり、堀と石垣が残る。
sights.whatEn: A park on the site of Sunpu Castle, where Tokugawa Ieyasu spent his later years, with moats, stone walls, the reconstructed Higashi-gomon Gate, Tatsumi-yagura, Hitsujisaru-yagura and Momijiyama Garden.
sights._source: https://sumpu-castlepark.com/ (公式): 2026年11月・12月のイベント案内掲載、住所 〒420-0855 静岡市葵区駿府城公園1-1。

sights.name: 静岡浅間神社
sights.what: 賤機山のふもとに鎮座する駿河国の総社。神部神社・浅間神社・大歳御祖神社の三社から成り、国の重要文化財の社殿群が並ぶ。平成の大改修を実施中。
sights.whatEn: The principal shrine of Suruga Province at the foot of Mount Shizuhata, comprising three shrines with nationally designated Important Cultural Property buildings. Long-term restoration work is underway.
sights._source: http://www.shizuokasengen.net/ (公式): 住所 〒420-0868 静岡市葵区宮ケ崎町102-1。平成の大改修実施中。

sights.name: 久能山東照宮
sights.what: 徳川家康を祀る全国東照宮の創祀。標高216メートルの久能山に鎮座し、総漆塗・極彩色の御社殿は国宝に指定されている。
sights.whatEn: The first of Japan’s Toshogu shrines, enshrining Tokugawa Ieyasu atop 216-metre Mount Kuno, with a lacquered, polychrome main hall designated a National Treasure.
sights._source: https://www.toshogu.or.jp/ (公式): 2026年（令和8年）10月のお知らせ掲載、標高216m、国宝御社殿。
